environment.description: Same provider backend deployed behind an ALB in us-west-2. The ALB has an AWS WAFv2 WebACL attached with a rule group reference statement. The referenced rule group is a custom rule group (not the AWS managed one directly) named 'tf-provider-protection' with capacity 700. This custom rule group contains a single nested rule group reference to the AWS managed rule group 'AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet' but with a scope-down statement that only inspects request bodies with content-type 'application/json' and applies JSON body parsing with match scope 'ALL' and oversize handling 'CONTINUE'. The custom rule group also has a secondary text transformation chain: URL_DECODE followed by COMPRESS_WHITE_SPACE applied before SQLi detection. The WebACL default action is ALLOW. The rule group action is set to BLOCK with custom response code 403. Note: the scope-down statement uses a ByteMatchStatement checking the Content-Type header contains 'json' with CONTAINS match type, meaning non-JSON requests bypass the rule entirely.

config.load_balancer: AWS ALB with WAFv2 WebACL association
config.note: Terraform CLI always sends Content-Type: application/json for provider RPCs
